title: CobbleEffortVR
description: When a Pokémon finishes a battle, it doesn't gain Effort Values, but instead increases general effort points, which you allocate yourself.
body:
### Mod Introduction
When a Pokémon finishes a battle, it doesn't gain Effort Values, but instead increases general effort points, which you allocate yourself.
### List of commands
 * /evpool get <player>
 * /evpool add <player> <amount>
 * /evpool set <player> <amount>
 * /evpool clear <player>
 *
 * /evpool evs set <player> <slot> <stat> <amount>
 * /evpool evs add <player> <slot> <stat> <amount>
 * /evpool evs clear <player> <slot> [<stat>]​
